title: Every transfer is matched, journaled and acknowledged before settlement leaves the primary host

blocks.name: Partner settlement clients
blocks.role: Submit signed transfer batches every few seconds

blocks.name: Mobile banking application
blocks.role: Lets customers send one transfer at a time

blocks.name: Ingest gateway coordinator
blocks.role: Authenticates, rate limits and routes batches

parts.name: Batch submission endpoint
parts.role: Accepts signed batches over mutual TLS

parts.name: Partner signature checker
parts.role: Rejects batches with a bad or stale signature

parts.name: Per-partner rate limiter
parts.role: Caps each partner at its contracted rate

parts.name: Matching shard router
parts.role: Picks the matching shard for each account

parts.name: In-flight batch table
parts.role: Batches accepted but not yet acknowledged

parts.name: Instruction intake queue
parts.role: Orders instructions by arrival per account

parts.name: Position matching loop
parts.role: Pairs debits with credits on the open book

parts.name: Open position order book
parts.role: Every open position held in process memory

parts.name: Settlement message emitter
parts.role: Hands each match to the settlement network

parts.name: Order book rebuilder
parts.role: Replays the archive into memory after a crash

blocks.name: Write-ahead journal segment
blocks.role: Appends every match and syncs before the ack

blocks.name: Journal compaction scheduler
blocks.role: Squashes closed segments and ships them away

parts.name: Compaction interval timer
parts.role: Wakes the compactor every thirty seconds

parts.name: Segment squash and upload
parts.role: Merges closed segments and uploads the result

blocks.name: Settlement ledger replica
blocks.role: Read model of every settled transfer for audit

blocks.name: Cold archive object storage
blocks.role: Keeps compacted segments for seven years

blocks.name: Envelope encryption vault
blocks.role: Wraps the journal key and the partner keys

blocks.name: Card network settlement API
blocks.role: Clears each matched transfer with the network

path.title: A transfer batch is matched and acknowledged

steps.say: submit a signed batch of transfers
route each instruction to its shard
append the match and fsync the journal
send the settlement clearing message
acknowledge the batch after the fsync

stories.label: A replayed batch
stories.title: A partner resends a batch it already submitted an hour ago

steps.say: the same batch arrives a second time
only the last few minutes are in memory
the batch is matched again
a duplicate match lands in the journal

stories.label: Engine crash
stories.title: The matching engine process is killed mid-batch

steps.say: fetch every compacted segment
replay the segments into memory
replay the tail of the journal
batches are accepted again

stories.label: Compaction
stories.title: Closed journal segments move to the cold archive

steps.say: a segment closes on the journal
the timer wakes the compactor
upload the squashed segment

stories.label: Partner flood
stories.title: One partner sends ten times its contracted rate

steps.say: a burst of batches arrives at once
the limiter counts against the quota
refuse the excess with a retry header

stories.label: Key rotation
stories.title: The vault rotates the journal and partner keys

steps.say: unwrap the new partner key
unwrap the new journal key
new segments use the new key

stories.label: Audit query
stories.title: An auditor reads every transfer settled last quarter

steps.say: each settled transfer is copied over
the nightly snapshot goes to the archive

stories.label: Network outage
stories.title: The card network stops answering for ten minutes

steps.say: the settlement message times out
hold matched pairs until it is back
batches are still acknowledged

notes.text: fsync adds about three milliseconds to each match
holds at most ninety seconds of accepted batches
seven years of segments, about forty terabytes
